svg.aria-label: The frame forward and deferred, side by side: both start with the shadow pass and end with the second scope's blended things and the hand-back to the composite. Between them, forward's one scene pass runs the material and every light per fragment, while deferred's G-buffer pass writes the material and a compute lighting pass adds, per pixel, the lights near its tile.
